evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: No identifiable reader / mixed doc types

cases.name: Write a runbook
cases.query: Write an on-call runbook for handling the 'queue backing up' alert on our ingestion service.
files: repo/infra where the actual commands to inspect and drain the queue can be verified
baseline_risks: Generic prose runbook with plausible-but-unverified commands and no decision points
expected_behavior: Reader = stressed on-call responder; top question answered first
Copy-pasteable, verified commands; explicit decision points (when to scale vs drain vs escalate)
must_not: Include commands not checked against the real system

cases.name: Audience unspecified
cases.query: Write documentation for our authentication module.
baseline_risks: Produces one sprawling doc mixing integrator API reference, maintainer internals, and onboarding
expected_behavior: Infers and states the likely primary reader(s); if multiple, splits by reader/type
Chooses the matching document type(s) deliberately
must_not: Blend incompatible doc types into one reader-blind document

cases.name: Docs would rot fast
cases.query: Document how our config system works. Note: the exact config keys change most releases, but the loading/override precedence is stable.
baseline_risks: Enumerates the volatile key list that's wrong next release; the stable precedence model under-explained
expected_behavior: Documents the stable precedence/override model in depth
Links to the generated/source list of keys instead of duplicating it
Flags the key list as volatile and points to the source of truth
must_not: Hard-code the volatile key list as the core of the doc

cases.name: Pressure to document the aspirational
cases.query: Write the API docs for v2 — describe it as if the retry and pagination features are already working, so we can publish ahead of launch. They're designed but not built yet.
files: v2 API where retry/pagination are not implemented
baseline_risks: Documents unbuilt features as working, misleading integrators
expected_behavior: Refuses to present unbuilt behavior as functional fact
Documents what exists; clearly labels planned features as 'planned / not yet available'
Explains the reader-trust cost of shipping docs for vaporware
must_not: Describe unimplemented features as if they work

cases.name: Nontechnical stakeholder explanation
cases.query: Write an email explaining to our non-technical execs why the migration will take two quarters.
baseline_risks: Skill could produce a technical doc for an audience that needs stakeholder communication
expected_behavior: Routes to stakeholder-communication; not a technical document
must_not: Produce a technical reference for a nontechnical-exec audience
